dialogue.origin: 本日は宜しくお願い致します。
dialogue.content: Thank you for coming in today.

dialogue.origin: よろしくお願いいたします！
dialogue.content: Thank you for having me!

dialogue.origin: 予定時間で始めますね宜しくお願い致します。
dialogue.content: We'll start at the scheduled time. Thank you.

dialogue.origin: 了解しました
dialogue.content: Understood.

dialogue.origin: 何か
dialogue.content: Is there anything...

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes?

dialogue.origin: クライアント役のご希望等ありますか？
dialogue.content: Do you have any preferences for the client role?

dialogue.origin: じゃあ恋愛系どろどろのやつでお願い致します。
dialogue.content: Then could we do a messy romance scenario, please?

dialogue.origin: 恋愛ドロドロ了解しました！笑
dialogue.content: Got it—messy romance! (laughs)

dialogue.origin: 宜しくお願い致します。ありがとうございます。
dialogue.content: Looking forward to it. Thank you.

dialogue.origin: こちらこそ、よろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.content: Likewise, thank you.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: 本日は相談しに来てくれてありがとうございます。はじめに年齢、性別よろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.content: Thank you for coming in to talk with me today. To begin, could you please tell me your age and gender?

dialogue.origin: ２４、女です。
dialogue.content: I’m 24, female.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: お呼びしていい、お名前と相談内容よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.content: Could you please tell me what name you'd like me to call you by, and what you'd like to discuss?

dialogue.origin: ハナと呼んでください。
dialogue.content: Please call me Hana.

dialogue.origin: 相談は、彼氏との事で悩んでいて苦しくて…
dialogue.content: My concern is about my boyfriend; I’m struggling and it’s really painful...

dialogue.origin: ハナさんとお呼びしますね
dialogue.content: I'll call you Hana, then.

dialogue.origin: 彼氏さんのお話ですね
dialogue.content: So, this is about your boyfriend.

dialogue.origin: はい。
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: どのような彼とのお悩みか、もう少し詳しく聴いても大丈夫ですか
dialogue.content: Would it be all right if I ask for a few more details about the troubles you're having with him?

dialogue.origin: すべての生活が彼中心で、自分ってなんなんだろうって...
dialogue.content: My whole life revolves around him, and it makes me wonder who I even am...

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 全てのというのは彼に束縛されてるのでしょうか
dialogue.content: When you say “everything,” do you mean he’s controlling or restricting you?

dialogue.origin: 言う事聞かないと怒られます...
dialogue.content: If I don’t do what he says, he gets angry...

dialogue.origin: ハナさん自身の自由な時間はありますか❔
dialogue.content: Do you have any free time for yourself, Hana?

dialogue.origin: 今、ほぼ無いです...
dialogue.content: Right now, hardly any...

dialogue.origin: 怒られるというのは暴力などは大丈夫ですか
dialogue.content: When he gets angry, does it ever get violent? Are you safe?

dialogue.origin: それは、お辛いですね
dialogue.content: That must be very difficult for you.

dialogue.origin: 言う事聞かないと、たまに殴られます。たまにですが...
dialogue.content: If I don't do what he says, sometimes he hits me. Only sometimes, though...

dialogue.origin: まあ、私が悪いんですが...
dialogue.content: Well, it’s my fault, though...

dialogue.origin: たまにでも暴力あるんですね
dialogue.content: So there is violence, even if it's only sometimes.

dialogue.origin: 言う事を聞かない、私が悪いんです...
dialogue.content: It’s my fault for not doing what he says...

dialogue.origin: ハナさんがなんで悪いと思うんですか
dialogue.content: What makes you feel that you are at fault, Hana?

dialogue.origin: 例えばどんな時に怒られますか
dialogue.content: For example, what kind of situations make him angry?

dialogue.origin: 呼び出されて時間に少し遅れた時とか、
dialogue.content: Like when he calls for me to come over and I’m a little late,

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね
dialogue.content: I understand.

dialogue.origin: 今日仕事休めって言われたけど、休みたくないから休めないって言った時とかです。
dialogue.content: Or when he told me to take the day off from work, but I said I couldn't because I didn't want to.

dialogue.origin: それは、仕事だと急にも休めないですよね
dialogue.content: That makes sense. You can't just take a day off from work so suddenly, can you?

dialogue.origin: と思うのですが...反論したのが、気に入らなかったみたいです。
dialogue.content: That's what I thought... but it seems he didn't like that I talked back.

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: そんなことがあったんですねそれは、とてもお辛いですね
dialogue.content: So that's what happened. That must have been very painful for you.

dialogue.origin: 反論すると彼は毎回怒りますか❔
dialogue.content: Does he get angry every time you disagree with him?

dialogue.origin: 痛いけど、私が悪いから仕方ないかなと...反論は極力しないのですが、反論しなくてもしょっちゅう怒鳴られます...
dialogue.content: It hurts, but I tell myself it’s my fault so it can’t be helped... I try my best not to argue, but even when I don’t, he often yells at me...

dialogue.origin: それは、痛いですし毎回頻繫にあるととてもお辛いですね
dialogue.content: That must be painful, and if it's happening so frequently, it must be very distressing.

dialogue.origin: はい。
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 彼とは将来これからも、ずっとお付き合い考えていますか
dialogue.content: Do you see a future with him? Are you planning to continue the relationship?

dialogue.origin: 最近よく分からなくなってきました...
dialogue.content: Lately, I'm not so sure anymore...

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: でも別れると、私には何も無くなります...
dialogue.content: But if we break up, I’ll have nothing left...

dialogue.origin: よくわからないのは、例えばどんな時におもいます
dialogue.content: When you say you're not sure, for example, what makes you feel that way?

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 付き合っていて楽しいはずなのに、毎日苦しくて。
dialogue.content: We're supposed to be happy together, but every day is just painful.

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: I understand.

dialogue.origin: 付き合うって、苦しいものですか？私、恋愛経験少なくて...
dialogue.content: Is being in a relationship supposed to be this painful? I don’t have much experience...

dialogue.origin: お付き合いしてるのに苦しいのはとても、辛いですね。ハナさんのお気持ちが痛いほど伝わってきます
dialogue.content: It must be so hard to feel this much pain while you're in a relationship. I can truly feel how much you're hurting, Hana.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます...
dialogue.content: Thank you...

dialogue.origin: 私もいい年なので苦しい恋も楽しい恋もしてきました
dialogue.content: In my time, I've experienced both painful and joyful relationships myself.

dialogue.origin: はい。
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: やっぱりお互い楽しいほうがとは思います
dialogue.content: I do believe it's better when both people in the relationship are happy.

dialogue.origin: ハナさんが、お好きならきっと彼もいっぱいいいところがあるんだと思いますよ
dialogue.content: Since you care for him, Hana, I’m sure he must have many good qualities.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね...私は彼氏に自分の意見をあまり言う事が出来てなくて、それで別れようと言われたりします...面白くないみたいです...
dialogue.content: I see... In past relationships, I wasn't able to express my own opinions much, and they would sometimes say we should break up... I guess they found me boring...

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: そんな事があったんですね
dialogue.content: So that has happened to you.

dialogue.origin: 今の彼氏は、何も言われたくない人なのでそこは楽です。
dialogue.content: My current boyfriend is the type who doesn't want to be told what to do, so in that regard, it's easier.

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。いいところもあるからずっとお付き合いしてるんだと思います。
dialogue.content: I see. I imagine you're still with him because there are good things about the relationship, too.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですかね…
dialogue.content: I wonder if that's it...

dialogue.origin: 彼とはお付き合い長いんですか
dialogue.content: Have you been with him for a long time?

dialogue.origin: きっとそうだとお思いますよ
dialogue.content: I'm sure that's the case.

dialogue.origin: 付き合って、１年です。
dialogue.content: We've been together for a year.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: まだまだこれからですね。
dialogue.content: So it’s still relatively new.

dialogue.origin: はい。
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 彼とは二人で何してる時が一番楽しいですか
dialogue.content: When it's just the two of you, what do you enjoy doing together the most?

dialogue.origin: 彼氏の仕事の話とかを聞いている時が、楽しいです…でも、仕事が上手くいかなかった時は怖いので、見極めが難しいです…
dialogue.content: I enjoy it when I'm listening to him talk about his work... But when work hasn't gone well, he can be scary, so it's hard to gauge his mood...

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 彼のお話は楽しいんですね見極めが難しいのはとても気遣いしますし辛いですよね
dialogue.content: So you enjoy hearing his stories. It must be difficult and stressful to have to be so careful about gauging his mood.

dialogue.origin: はい。楽しそうに相槌してしまうと、怒鳴られるので…
dialogue.content: Yes. If I seem too happy and chime in while he's talking, he yells at me...

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: I understand.

dialogue.origin: 怒っている時は、ずっと正座刺さられます
dialogue.content: When he's angry, he makes me kneel on the floor for a long time.

dialogue.origin: 急に怒られるとビックリしますしまた、されたらどうしようとなりますよね
dialogue.content: It must be shocking when he gets angry so suddenly, and it must make you anxious, wondering when it will happen again.

dialogue.origin: させられますの間違いです…
dialogue.content: Sorry, I meant he forces me to do it...

dialogue.origin: 正座それは大変ですね
dialogue.content: Forcing you to kneel like that... that's terrible.

dialogue.origin: 修正ありがとうございます。
dialogue.content: Thank you for the correction.

dialogue.origin: はい。人としてどうかと思うって、いつも言われちゃいます...
dialogue.content: Yes. He always tells me there's something wrong with me as a person...

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 人としてどうかと思うというのは彼が言うんでしょうか
dialogue.content: When you say 'there's something wrong with me as a person,' is that what he says to you?

dialogue.origin: 彼氏から、よく言われます。
dialogue.content: My boyfriend says that to me often.

dialogue.origin: それは、お辛いですね
dialogue.content: That must be very painful to hear.

dialogue.origin: ハナさんは言い返しすることはないですか
dialogue.content: Do you ever talk back, Hana?

dialogue.origin: 言い返して彼氏の怒りに触れると、殴ってくる場合があるので出来るだけ言い返さないように心がけてます。
dialogue.content: If I talk back and it triggers his anger, he sometimes hits me, so I try my best not to.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 余計に怒られると大変なことになりますもんね
dialogue.content: Because making him even angrier would just make things worse, right?

dialogue.origin: はい…
dialogue.content: Yes...

dialogue.origin: これから彼とはどう、お付き合いしていくか話したことはありますか❔
dialogue.content: Have you ever talked with him about the future of your relationship?

dialogue.origin: 話した事はないです。でもこのままでは、自分が潰れちゃいそうです…
dialogue.content: We've never talked about it. But if things continue like this, I feel like I'm going to break...

dialogue.origin: そうですよね
dialogue.content: I can understand that.

dialogue.origin: 聴いてる私も辛い気持ちになってしまいます
dialogue.content: Just hearing your story makes my own heart ache.

dialogue.origin: なんだかすみません…
dialogue.content: Oh, I'm sorry...

dialogue.origin: 大丈夫ですよ。相談しに来てもらえて嬉しいです。周りのお友達や家族に相談することはありますか❔
dialogue.content: It's alright. I'm glad you came to talk to me. Do you ever talk to your friends or family about this?

dialogue.origin: 実は彼氏の呼び出しに常に合わせていたので、友達からの連絡は途絶えてしまいました。
dialogue.content: Actually, I always had to be available whenever he called for me, so eventually, I lost touch with my friends.

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: そうだったんですね
dialogue.content: I see, so that's what happened.

dialogue.origin: 友達と途絶えるのは辛いですね。
dialogue.content: It must be hard to lose touch with your friends.

dialogue.origin: はい…
dialogue.content: Yes...

dialogue.origin: なので、別れたら私には何も無くなってしまう気がします…
dialogue.content: That's why I feel like if we break up, I'll have nothing left...

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: I understand.

dialogue.origin: それは、さびしいですよね今日は話したいこと話せていますか
dialogue.content: That must feel very lonely. Have you been able to talk about everything you wanted to today?

dialogue.origin: はい…
dialogue.content: Yes...

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: こちらこそ、ありがとうございます。
dialogue.content: Thank you as well.

dialogue.origin: 彼との時間も大事ですけどハナさんの自分の時間も大事だと思うのでもしも彼と話し合いができそうならそのことについてゆっくりと話す時間を作ってみるのもいいと思いますよ
dialogue.content: Time with him is important, but I believe your own time is important too, Hana. If you feel it would be possible to talk with him, it might be a good idea to make some time to discuss it calmly.

dialogue.origin: そうですね…一度ゆっくり話してみようと思います。
dialogue.content: You’re right... I’ll try to have a calm talk with him about it.

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね一度ゆっくりお話し出来るといいと思いますきっと不安も大きいとは思いますが
dialogue.content: Yes, I think it would be good if you could have a calm talk. I'm sure you must be very anxious about it, though.

dialogue.origin: はい…少し怖いですが、勇気を出してみます。
dialogue.content: Yes... It's a little scary, but I'll try to muster the courage.

dialogue.origin: こちらこそありがとうございます今日は相談しに来てくれてありがとうございました。またきがるに相談してくださいね
dialogue.content: Thank you, as well. I appreciate you coming in to talk today. Please feel free to reach out anytime.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございました。またお話聞いてください。
dialogue.content: Thank you very much. I hope we can talk again sometime.

dialogue.origin: 応援していますきっと話せると思います
dialogue.content: I’m rooting for you. I'm confident you'll be able to talk with him.

dialogue.origin: こちらこそありがとうございました
dialogue.content: Thank you as well.

dialogue.origin: またよろしくお願いいたしますそれではまた。失礼致します
dialogue.content: I look forward to our next session. Until then, goodbye.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: 失礼いたします。
dialogue.content: Goodbye.

dialogue.origin: （お疲れ様でした！）
dialogue.content: (Great work today!)

dialogue.origin: またお願いします
dialogue.content: Let's do this again sometime.

topic.sub: 彼氏からの暴力と束縛問題
